items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: An action, or a link that looks like one: variants, sizes, an icon, a loading state.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short status or count next to text: default, secondary, outline, destructive.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field with a focus ring, a disabled state and an invalid state.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line field for a message or a note.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The visible name of a field, tied to its control.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, a control, help and the error, wired together with aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: On or off for one option, with a label you can click and a disabled state.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off setting that applies at once.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A panel with a header, content and a footer, for settings, summaries and plans.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between groups, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message on the page: a title, a line and an icon, neutral or destructive.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key or a shortcut of several keys.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A face, with initials when the photo is missing; in a row as a group.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Panels behind a row of tabs, arrow keys between them.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal that keeps focus inside, closes on Escape and returns focus to its trigger.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A menu behind a button: items with icons and shortcuts, checkbox items and groups.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: The native select, styled: groups, a placeholder and disabled options, no JavaScript.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label on hover and keyboard focus.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Short confirmations that appear and leave on their own, with an action to undo.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice from a few, with hints under each option; arrow keys choose.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links with Previous and Next, the current page marked and gaps where pages are skipped.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where the page sits: the levels as links, separators, a collapsed middle and the current page.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder in the shape of the content while it loads.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows and columns with a caption, a header and a footer, right-aligned numbers.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open one at a time or together, with the keyboard model and a height animation.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How far along a task is, as a bar with its value read out.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value or a range on a track, with arrow keys and the value shown.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel next to its trigger for a short form or details; Escape and outside clicks close it.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command menu
items.description: A command palette: type to filter, arrows and Enter, grouped commands and shortcuts.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: A search input in a role=search form, with a / shortcut and a clear button.

items.name: sidebar-nav
items.title: Sidebar navigation
items.description: A docs sidebar: groups of links, the current page marked, groups that fold open and shut.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A side sheet for filters, a cart or details: slides in from its edge, focus stays inside.

items.name: link-list
items.title: Link list
items.description: Links as rows with a title, a line and a chevron; the whole row is the target.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Nothing here yet, or no results: an icon, what is going on and what to do next.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A topic or an active filter: static, a link, or removable with focus moving to the next tag.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: Toggle chips, a sort choice and a live result count; Clear turns every filter off.

items.name: filter-sheet
items.title: Filter sheet
items.description: The phone Filters button: active count, checkbox groups in a side sheet, Clear all and Show results.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Progress through a flow: done, current (aria-current=step) and to come; horizontal when there is room.

items.name: quantity
items.title: Quantity
items.description: Minus, a number field and plus as one control; the buttons turn off at the ends.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code with a filename bar and a Copy button, in a focusable scroll box.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A swipeable row with Previous and Next that turn off at the ends, keyboard included. No autoplay.

items.name: date-field
items.title: Date field
items.description: The native date input in the field style, or a from–to range whose end can never fall before its start.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of controls that is one Tab stop; arrows move. Toggle buttons, and a "Was this helpful?" row.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies a value, an element's text or a file from your site, then says Copied for a moment, announced to screen readers.

items.name: read-aloud
items.title: Read aloud
items.description: Listen to an article: the browser's own speech reads it, with pause, resume and stop. Nothing leaves the page.

items.name: language-switcher
items.title: Language switcher
items.description: The page's other languages as links with lang and hreflang behind one button; the current one is marked.

items.name: toc
items.title: On this page
items.description: A page's sections as links; the one you are reading is marked while you scroll.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Inline in text, standalone with an arrow, or external with an arrow out and a new-tab note for screen readers.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icons
items.description: Lucide, the icon set shadcn/ui draws with: a stroke, a size, a label when they stand alone.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: A server-rendered column chart with values on top and the same data as a table for screen readers. No chart library.

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video player
items.description: A poster with one Play button; native controls and captions once it plays. Nothing plays by itself.

items.name: map-embed
items.title: Map
items.description: A location whose map loads from OpenStreetMap only when asked; the address works as a link without it.

items.name: story-card
items.title: Story card
items.description: Picture, kicker, the title as the one link, a line and the meta; standard, compact, wide and feature.

items.name: section-header
items.title: Section header
items.description: The head of a page section: a kicker, the heading, a line or two and an optional action, on the type scale.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: A single-choice toggle group drawn as one track, like a monthly/yearly switch.

items.name: result-list
items.title: Search results
items.description: An announced count, then ranked results with the address and the match marked in each snippet.

items.name: announcement
items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: A one-line site notice with a read-more link and a close button that can stay closed for the session.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Journey-planner hero: from/to card with leave-at tabs, a day-out photo card and four quick-task tiles.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Three plan cards under a monthly/yearly switch, the middle one framed with a tab, beside a photo card for schools.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Bold questions in hairline rows that open as native details, beside a heading and a front-desk card with phone.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site header
items.description: A muted service strip over a 72px bar: wordmark, six centred links, a pill search and saved and bag counts.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site footer
items.description: Brand and a call-us card, five dense link columns, then trust marks, legal links and an age notice.

items.name: newsletter
items.title: Newsletter signup
items.description: A grocery's weekly offers letter in one tinted band: a produce photo, the pitch, an inline email field and three facts.

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact form
items.description: A developer tool's contact card: pitch, reply times and a customer quote beside a labelled form with topic chips.

items.name: logo-strip
items.title: Logo strip
items.description: One centred line over seven client wordmarks set in type, in one grey row, with a case-study link.

items.name: login-form
items.title: Login form
items.description: An energy supplier's sign-in card with a show/hide password, secondary ways in and a side strip of other routes.

items.name: breadcrumb-trail
items.title: Breadcrumb trail
items.description: A home icon and chevron levels on one line above a category title; on a phone the middle folds, the last truncates.

items.name: card-carousel
items.title: Card carousel
items.description: A garden store's weekly offers: a photo lead card, then product cards with deal badges and prices that scroll sideways.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison table
items.description: An honest strong/weak box over a three-way table: your column shaded with its call to action, ticks, real figures.

items.name: header-bar
items.title: Header bar
items.description: A slim docs bar: mark, centred section tabs with the current one in a pill, Blog and a dark Console button.

items.name: lift-card
items.title: Lift cards
items.description: A photo tile and four tall centred link tiles that lift on hover, for an electric van dealer's ways to buy.

items.name: link-card
items.title: Link cards
items.description: Four city photo tiles with an inset frame, the city name and a home count; each tile is one link.

items.name: plain-tiles
items.title: Plain tiles
items.description: Three open photo tiles with a step, a title and two lines each under a centred heading; no card chrome.

items.name: split-card
items.title: Split card
items.description: One wide card: a tall photo left, then heading, story, a checked list and a pill button with a price line.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature grid
items.description: Centred heading over a bento of muted tiles, each with a small product view; one large insight tile and a photo tile.

items.name: call-to-action
items.title: Call to action
items.description: Closing panel with a very large centred title, three pill actions (call, mail, book) and the founders' faces.

items.name: stats-row
items.title: Stats row
items.description: Header and intro over a staggered strip of four studio photos, then three very large figures under thin rules.

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: One large quote in a soft grey panel, a face with name and role, and the customer's own figures under a rule.

items.name: post-grid
items.title: Post grid
items.description: A hospital newsroom: tinted header band, nine photo cards with tag and date in a 3×3 grid, and a load-more button.

items.name: changelog-list
items.title: Changelog list
items.description: Four latest releases on a horizontal timeline with dates, versions and tags, earlier releases in a compact list below.

items.name: free-home
items.title: Home page
items.description: A whole home page from nine free blocks, filled in for a car and passenger ferry: a sailing planner up top, the islands, books of ten crossings, an islander's word, the fleet in figures, questions and the sailing notes.

items.name: free-sign-in
items.title: Sign-in page
items.description: A whole sign-in page from the login-form block, filled in for a sailing school: the card with other ways in beside it, the sailing office's number and today's sailing conditions.

items.name: free-pricing
items.title: Pricing page
items.description: A whole pricing page from seven free blocks, filled in for a booking tool for hair and barber salons: three plans with a monthly and yearly switch, the salons that use it, an honest comparison, an owner's word and the questions people ask.

items.name: free-contact
items.title: Contact page
items.description: A whole contact page from free blocks and components, filled in for a three-vet practice: the message form with every way to reach the vets, a map and the opening hours, the vets themselves and the questions reception hears most.

items.name: free-blog
items.title: Blog index
items.description: A whole blog index from free blocks and components, filled in for a sourdough bakery's journal: the title and topic tags, a lead story, a grid of the latest posts, numbered pages and a weekly letter.
